reference_sql:
WITH numbered AS (  -- one row per subscription_events row dated on or before 2025-06-30
  SELECT subscription_id, mrr_delta_local,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT subscription_id,
       SUM(mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_with_copies,
       SUM(mrr_delta_local) FILTER (WHERE copy_no = 1) AS mrr
FROM numbered
GROUP BY subscription_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE copy_no = 1)
alternatives:
WITH events AS (  -- one row per event dated on or before 2025-06-30
  SELECT subscription_id, mrr_delta_local, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local
)
SELECT subscription_id, SUM(mrr_delta_local * n_rows) AS mrr_with_copies, SUM(mrr_delta_local) AS mrr
FROM events
GROUP BY subscription_id
HAVING SUM(n_rows) > COUNT(*)

SELECT t.subscription_id,
       SUM(t.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_with_copies,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.copy_no = 1 THEN t.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS mrr
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription_events row dated on or before 2025-06-30
  SELECT subscription_id, mrr_delta_local,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
) AS t
GROUP BY t.subscription_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > SUM(CASE WHEN t.copy_no = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

WITH d AS (SELECT subscription_id, mrr_delta_local, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS rn FROM subscription_events WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-06-30')
SELECT subscription_id, SUM(mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_with_copies, SUM(mrr_delta_local) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS mrr
FROM d GROUP BY subscription_id HAVING COUNT(*) > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1)
